messages:
morgan: starting prod ship for release v2.14.0 in ~10m. deploy-bot already kicked off canary. need someone to press final PROD button — my personal deploy key expired after the rotation earlier today.

deploy-bot: [bot] deploy pipeline triggered: release=v2.14.0, stage=canary, run_id=ab12cd. status=canary_in_progress. awaiting manual prod approval.

kevin: @morgan i can't press either — getting 403 from deploy API: 'token revoked'. looks like the key rotation happened this morning and my principal isn't bound anymore.

anya: i rotated the deploy key as part of the morning ops rotation. did we publish the new approvers list? i thought kevin was added to the temp-press group for today.

chris: we updated the ops notes but forgot to push the IAM binding. my bad — added kevin to the doc but didn't run the apply.

ops-oncall: oncall checked IAM: prod-press currently bound only to service-account:deployer-old. i can grant kevin a time-limited binding for this press if someone approves. need a :thumbsup: from @morgan or @anya to proceed.

morgan: +1 from me. please do a time-limited grant and include an audit reason: 'prod ship v2.14.0 emergency grant'. we should also log the PR link that generated the rotation.

ops-oncall: doing a 15m grant now. will annotate audit logs and channel. applying role binding...

deploy-bot: [bot] permission change detected: user=kevin added_to_role=prod-press (expires_in=15m). deploy action pending manual 'press' by kevin.

kevin: pressing now: `./deploy --confirm prod --release v2.14.0`

deploy-bot: [bot] PROD deploy initiated by kevin. rollout: 0->100% across regions with staged canary bakes. logs/CI: https://ci.redwood/ab12cd. monitoring dashboards: https://dash.redwood/prod-rollout/ab12cd

morgan: thanks all. quick note: rotation checklist needs an explicit step to update IAM bindings and the approvers page before rotating keys. i'll open a PR against infra-playbooks.

anya: i'll add a retro action to ensure ops rotation runs the `iam-sync` job and that we fail rotation if binding mismatched. also adding a smoke test that fails the deploy if approver list != IAM role members.

chris: can we make deploy-bot run a preflight check to compare approvers doc vs IAM binding and block auto-promote to prod if mismatch? filing ticket and cc @eng-platform.

morgan: agree — ticket please. also flagging cost of manual grants in the runbook.

ops-oncall: temporary grant applied and now auto-expired. audit entry: "prod ship v2.14.0 emergency grant — granted to kevin by ops-oncall, approved by morgan". no anomalies observed during rollout. closing temporary grant.

kevin: confirm deploy healthy, saw no errors in post-deploy smoke. thanks for the fast handoff. :tada:
